decision.explanation: The query '64th Division' refers to distinct military entities found in the source documents. Document D1 (British Army) explicitly states the '64th (2nd Highland) Division' was formed in 'late 1914' (D1S2, D1S3). Documents D2 and D3 (Imperial Japanese Army) state the '64th Division' was formed on '1 May 1943' (D2S3, D3S3). As these are distinct valid referents (different armies, different nations, different times), both years are correct answers to the ambiguous query. Other documents (D4-D6) discuss the '64th Air Division' or '6th Pursuit Wing/6th Air Division', which are different entities and do not provide formation years for the specific '64th Division' infantry units requested.
